text:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to lock the chat completions surface for the April launch. Customers are asking for both messages+roles and a backward-compatible `prompt` alias. Can we agree on scope?
ryan: Two parts: API shape + rollout/rollback. We should aim for a single endpoint that accepts messages as canonical, but accepts `prompt` for compatibility. Low friction for SDKs.
chris: Implementation cost: accepting `prompt` means a server-side translation step. Not huge, but we need to be careful about token accounting and model routing. Also affects streaming behavior.
maria: From customers: enterprise legal teams want a hard system-role enforcement (immutable system role) and deterministic structured outputs (JSON schema + function/tool calling). They also asked for a migration story.
vince: Proposal: canonical `messages: [{role,name?,content}]`. Optional top-level `prompt` string that the server converts to `messages=[{role:"user",content:prompt}]` for compatibility. Add a clear deprecation timeline in the header/response when `prompt` used.
sara: Launch criteria ideas: 1) SDKs support both shapes, 2) canary in prod w/ 10% orgs for 48h with shadowing, 3) p95 latency delta < 15%, 4) no schema-validation regressions for structured outputs > 99.5% pass rate, 5) documented rollback.
chris: For rollback: fallback policy should be model-level + shape-level. If new handler fails, route to old completions endpoint (completions-style prompt) as fallback. Need an automated circuit-breaker that flips after N errors or error rate threshold.
elaine: Agree with circuit-breaker. Also want a list of visible signals for PMs: regen rate, structured-output validation fail rate, token delta, cost delta, latency p50/p95, top error types.
maria: On structured outputs: suggest server-side schema validation hook and a `structured_output_status` field in responses (ok/soft_fail/hard_fail) with the original text returned on soft_fail plus `validation_errors`. Also support `function_call` as a first-class opt-in.
dev-rel-bot: FYI: auto-generated migration guide draft posted to #docs in 2h, will include examples for messages and prompt shim + SDK snippets.
ryan: Can we agree minimal launch surface? My vote: - Mandatory: `messages` canonical, roles (system/user/assistant) enforced, optional `prompt` shim w/ deprecation header, streaming preserved. - Optional-but-shipped: `function_call` integration + schema validation (beta flag per org). - Rollout: canary 10% orgs -> 50% -> 100% over 2 weeks, with circuit-breaker thresholds.
vince: Example canonical payload for docs (will include in guide):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "redwood-alpha-1",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Summarize sales call notes."}
  ],
  "functions": [{"name":"extract_entities","parameters":{...}}],
  "schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"}}}
}
```
elaine: Perfect. Action items: Chris + Vince own the server-side shim and circuit-breaker (due EOW). Maria owns structured-output validation design + customer communication. Ryan owns rollout plan + metrics dashboard. DevRel will seed migration docs. I'll compile launch criteria into a checklist and post later. :thumbsup:
ryan: One more ask — add a metrics alert for "schema hard_fail > 0.1% over 1h" and "token delta > 10% p95". If either triggers, rollback automatically to previous handler.
elaine: OK locking this as the working plan unless anyone objects by EOD. If not, I'll add to the roadmap and kickoff the implementation tickets. :rocket:
